brand_dna.category: Local Sunshine Coast butcher selling ethically farmed meat via in-store, click-and-collect, and a build-your-own Meat Club delivery box.
brand_dna.core_belief: Eat local, eat fresh - paddock to plate meat from ethical farmers, where 'the only thing we add is pride'.
proof_points: Sourced directly from local farms on the Sunshine Coast and surrounds
All meat is free-range, ethically raised, hormone and antibiotic-free
Some suppliers certified organic (e.g. OBE Organics, Certified Organic sausages); each product specifies its source
Butcher-selected and cut fresh, with a 'we will make it right' freshness guarantee
brand_dna.positioning: Premium local butcher and a trusted alternative to supermarket meat, built on ethical sourcing and personal service.

voice_pillars.name: Proud Local
voice_pillars.desc: Grounds every message in the Noosa and South East Queensland community and supporting local over big supermarkets.

voice_pillars.name: Butcher-Honest
voice_pillars.desc: Plainly names quality, sourcing and the natural variation of real meat without overselling.
voice_pillars.quote: The only thing we add is pride.

voice_pillars.name: Warm and Confident
voice_pillars.desc: Friendly, welcoming tone that stands behind the product and makes things right if they fall short.
voice_pillars.quote: Freshness guaranteed: If anything arrives less than perfect, we will make it right.

voice_pillars.name: Easy and Flexible
voice_pillars.desc: Reassures customers the Meat Club fits their life with no lock-in.

phrases: Build Your Premium Meat Box in Minutes
butcher-selected favourites, packed fresh and delivered cold
Fresh, farm-to-table meat delivered to your door
Butcher Selected Premium Quality Cold Delivered
farmers who share our passion for quality and animal welfare

icp: Sunshine Coast and Noosa Hinterland home cooks and families who have given up on declining supermarket meat and will pay more for local, ethically raised produce and a real butcher's advice.

personas.name: The Ethical Local Family
personas.description: Households wanting free-range, hormone-free meat from farmers they trust - moved by 'support a local small business instead of big supermarkets'.

personas.name: The Convenience Subscriber
personas.description: Busy locals who want quality meat without the shop run - moved by a flexible Meat Club you can skip, pause, or cancel anytime with free delivery.

personas.name: The Weekend Griller
personas.description: BBQ and entertaining enthusiasts after premium cuts and prep tips - moved by butcher-selected favourites and standout sausages, burgers and steak.

offers: Free delivery on one-off orders over $200 (Sunshine Coast wide)
Free delivery on subscriber orders over $150
Meat Club subscription: weekly options (every 1, 2, 3 or 4 weeks), build your own box, choose delivery date
Skip, pause, or cancel anytime before your weekly cut-off (no penalty)
Home delivery to select Sunshine Coast and Noosa Hinterland postcodes, or Click & Collect in store

allowed.claim: Free-range, ethically raised, hormone and antibiotic-free meat.
Sourced directly from local farms on the Sunshine Coast and surrounds.
Free delivery on one-off orders over $200 and subscriber orders over $150.
Skip, pause, or cancel anytime before your weekly cut-off.
If anything arrives less than perfect, we will make it right.
Some suppliers are certified organic; each product specifies its source.

banned.claim: Calling all products 'certified organic' or organic across the board.
banned.why: FTC substantiation - only some suppliers are certified; site states others may not carry certification. An unqualified organic claim is unprovable.

banned.claim: 'The best butcher in the world' or '#1 butcher in Australia'.
banned.why: Banned unqualified superlative - not provable and beyond the local scope the brand supports.

banned.claim: 'Makes the best pies in Queensland - guaranteed' as a brand claim.
banned.why: Testimonial outlier and unqualified superlative; a single review cannot be run as a substantiated brand guarantee.

banned.claim: 'Rated 5/5 by 130+ Happy Customers' unless the exact count and rating are current and verifiable.
banned.why: FTC - review counts and ratings must be truthful, current and not inflated or invented.

banned.claim: 'Order now - only hours left' style countdown urgency.
banned.why: Fake urgency is banned; deadlines must be real (actual delivery cut-off times only).

banned.claim: Guaranteed exact delivery time to the minute.
banned.why: Guaranteed results banned; shipping policy states delivery times are indicative only and cannot be guaranteed to the minute.
